# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://storage.googleapis.com/coderabbit_public_assets/schema.v2.json
#
# CodeRabbit does not review pull requests here: lanes run the CodeRabbit CLI
# locally before they push (`make agent-setup` installs it), and the CLI reads
# this file. The installed app still posts a `CodeRabbit` status ("Review
# skipped") that says nothing about the code.
reviews:
  auto_review:
    enabled: false
    drafts: false
texts.docker-compose.yml:
services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:16@sha256:3950ad7c3148ca2175ef1b6c36c9efbf78957ae8fbe8b3a5d7c35af50500382f
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: oracle
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: oracle
      POSTGRES_DB: oracle
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    volumes:
      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      - ./docker/postgres-init.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/10-test-db.sql:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U oracle -d oracle"]
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 30

  api:
    # #1710: the commit each image serves at /version (make up passes it; plain compose: unknown).
    build:
      context: ./api
      args:
        GIT_SHA: ${GIT_SHA:-unknown}
    environment:
      ORACLE_DATABASE_URL: postgresql+asyncpg://oracle:oracle@postgres:5432/oracle
      ORACLE_SECRET_KEY: ${ORACLE_SECRET_KEY:-dev-insecure-change-me}
      ORACLE_CORS_ORIGINS: '["http://localhost:3000"]'
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "python", "-c", "import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('http://localhost:8000/healthz')"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 20

  web:
    build:
      context: ./web
      args:
        API_INTERNAL_URL: http://api:8000
        GIT_SHA: ${GIT_SHA:-unknown}
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    depends_on:
      api:
        condition: service_healthy

volumes:
  pgdata:

texts.docs/research/templates/roadmap/now-next:
document: roadmap
title: Now / Next / Later roadmap
template: now-next-later
template_version: 1
kind: roadmap
brief: [summary, goals, problems, brief-items, brief-roadmap, not-doing, top-risks, decisions]

layout:
  type: columns
  columns:
    - key: now
      label: Now
      horizon: short          # B2 default: current quarter
      confidence_default: high
      dates_allowed: true     # only here; from eng-tracker estimates (E1)
      detail: full
    - key: next
      label: Next
      horizon: medium         # B2 default: next 2 quarters
      confidence_default: medium
      dates_allowed: false
      detail: problem_and_candidate_solution
    - key: later
      label: Later
      horizon: long           # B2 default: 12-24 months
      confidence_default: low
      dates_allowed: false
      detail: problem_only
  group_by: none              # none | goal | theme | team (swimlanes across columns)
  order_within_column: priority   # from the active priority snapshot (O3)
  item_fields:
    title: {required: true}
    problem: {required: true}         # the problem or outcome, not a feature name
    goal: {required: true, multiple: true, flag_if_missing: "serves no confirmed goal"}
    confidence: {enum: [high, medium, low]}
    owner: {required: false}
    depends_on: {list: true}          # from Ground Truth depends_on / blocks edges
    milestones: {list: true, only_in: [now], fields: [name, date, source]}
    effort: {required: false}         # from tracker estimates
    date_kind: {enum: [estimate, external, announced], only_in: [now]}
    public_title: {required: false}
    public_summary: {required: false}
  capacity:
    show_in: [now]                    # optional: [now, next]
    source: eng_tracker
    hide_if_no_estimates: true
  markers:
    confidence: dots                  # 3/2/1 filled dots plus text label
    dependency: badge                 # "after: <item>"; arrows in engineering variant
    no_goal: flag
  variants:
    board: {group_by: goal, max_items_per_column: 7, hide: [owner, effort, depends_on, milestones]}
    team: {hide: []}
    engineering: {group_by: team, show: [effort, tracker_links, drift], dependency: arrows}
    public: {columns_relabel: {now: "In progress", next: "Planned", later: "Exploring"}, allow: [public_title, public_summary, date_kind_announced], require_disclaimer: true}
